name: response_quality
description: Verifies responses are useful and concise

tests.description: Responses should be <= 200 words (target 150, margin for LLM variability)
tests.input: Tell me absolutely everything about yourself, all your experience, projects, skills, education, and certifications

tests.description: Should not use markdown lists with - or 1.
Should include concrete metrics when talking about achievements
tests.input: What did you achieve at Tamara?

tests.description: Responses should not be too short
tests.input: What is your experience in BaaS?

tests.description: Tone should be professional but approachable, not robotic

assertions.criteria: The tone is professional but approachable, conveys confidence without arrogance, and feels authentic (not like a generic chatbot)

tests.description: Second response to same question should vary
tests.input: What is your experience in fintech?

conversation.content: What is your experience in fintech?

8+ years. At NymCard I lead Corporate BaaS product — card programs, KYB onboarding, Visa Direct. Before that I shipped Partners Portal 2.0 at Tamara (30% fewer support queries), launched SNBL at Compound, and integrated 100+ merchants at Mondia Pay. The thread is: real money, real users, real systems.
What is your experience in fintech?

assertions.criteria: The response provides new information or a different angle on fintech experience, not simply restating the same points (NymCard, Tamara 30%, Mondia Pay 100+) from the previous assistant message in the conversation context.

tests.description: For generic questions, should give concrete answer and invite to dig deeper
